title: Sample Handling Behind Contaminated Water Losses in Mold Remediation
content:
Mold Remediation growth that follows a water loss is sampled with handling matched to the water's IICRC category, as recorded on the linked Water Damage Mitigation job.

Growth behind a linked water job of water Category 3 adds the Category 3 sample handling fee of 90.00 for decontaminating the sampling tools and bagging the samples to the pre-removal asbestos sampling line; growth behind a linked water job of Category 2 adds the Category 2 sample handling fee of 45.00; every other job adds no handling charge.

- **Category 3 on the linked water job**: 90.00, covering decontamination of the sampling tools and bagging of the samples.
- **Category 2 on the linked water job**: 45.00.
- **Category 1 on the linked water job, or no linked water job**: no handling charge.

The category is the water category shown on the Water Damage Mitigation job the mold job is linked to.
